    from sys import stdin, stdout

    n, m = map(int, stdin.readline().split())
    constraints = [tuple(map(int, stdin.readline().split())) for _ in range(m)]

    a = [0] * n
    for li, ri, qi in constraints:
        for j in range(li - 1, ri):
            a[j] |= qi

    for li, ri, qi in constraints:
        if not all((a[j] & qi) == qi for j in range(li - 1, ri)):
            stdout.write("NO\n")
            return

    stdout.write("YES\n")
    stdout.write(" ".join(map(str, a)) + "\n")

main()
